A '''diiro''' was a weapon commonly used by the [[Sathari/Legends|Sathari]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]]. The weapons consisted of a hollow alloy blade at the end of a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] handle. The blade was often filled with [[Poison/Legends|poison]].<ref name="CotG" />
